cards.name: confirmed
cards.spec: A sale is either confirmed or not. New sales start as not confirmed.

cards.name: confirm_sale
cards.spec: confirm_sale also sets sale.confirmed to True and saves the sale after lowering the stock. If sale.confirmed is already True it raises ValueError and changes nothing, so no stock is lowered twice.

cards.name: cancel_sale
cards.spec: cancel_sale(sale) undoes a confirmed sale. If sale.confirmed is False it raises ValueError and changes nothing. Otherwise it adds each item's quantity back to its product's stock (items from sale.saleitem_set), saves each product, sets sale.confirmed to False and saves the sale.
